Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

headache — a pain in your head. Example: I have got a headache.
fever — a body temperature that is too high. Example: She has got a fever.
cold — a common illness with sneezing. Example: He has got a cold.
cough — a sudden noise from your chest when ill. Example: I have got a bad cough.
pain — a feeling that something hurts. Example: The pain is in my head.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I have got a headache.
• She has got a fever.
• I have got a cold.
• It is a bad cough.
• Where is the pain?
